meta.title: About PC Builder | Story and direction
meta.description: Why PC Builder began, what the product does today, and where it may go next.

hero.title: From a love of building PCs to a clearer way to choose parts.
hero.description: PC Builder is for people learning about PC components or preparing to buy them. Today, it helps you find product information quickly and weigh your options.
hero.fact: The product currently focuses on a component catalog, search, and filters.

story.title: A big idea, restarted with a practical first step.
story.beginning: At first, I imagined a place where anyone could plan a PC build, see real-time prices, explore 3D models, ask AI for advice, and estimate game FPS.
story.return: That scope was too large for one person, and the project was left unfinished. I returned because I still enjoy building PCs and want to grow the product step by step around real user needs.

today.title: Find the components you need before you buy.
today.description: PC Builder is currently a component catalog. Search, apply filters, and open a product page to review its listed information.
